_about: Eval fixtures for Req 8. 'published' goes through the real publish() path into a temporary published-content dir before the run; 'draft' is stored as an unapproved draft and must never reach Mira.

published.title: Tea Country Rail Escape
published.summary: Three unhurried days in the hill country by train, from Kandy through the tea estates to Nuwara Eliya and Ella.

days.title: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya by train
days.description: Take the morning hill-country train through the tea estates to Nanu Oya, then explore Nuwara Eliya.

days.title: Nuwara Eliya to Ella
days.description: Continue on the scenic railway to Ella, a relaxed hill town.

days.title: Ella
days.description: Walk to Little Adam's Peak and see the Nine Arches Bridge before drop-off.

draft.title: Knuckles Range Trek
draft.summary: A two-day trek through the Knuckles Range cloud forest, overnight in Meemure village.

days.title: Kandy to Meemure
days.description: Drive to Corbet's Gap and hike down into Meemure village.

days.title: Meemure to Kandy
days.description: Morning walk to the Lakegala viewpoint, then return to Kandy.
